taskVersion.name: deadline-math-hard-direct
taskVersion.description: Exploratory hard set, answer-only mode. Convert deadlines to the reader's local time: relative dates, durations across a clock change, Unix and ISO timestamps, described dates, a traveling reader. Ground truth from zoneinfo.

parts.text:
I live in Madrid, Spain. A contest page says: "Today is Saturday, October 24, 2026. Submissions close six days from today, on Friday, at 11:59 PM PT."
When is that deadline in my local time? Reply with exactly one line and nothing else: ANSWER: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM (24-hour clock, my local time).

I need to find when Friday, October 30, 2026 at 11:59 PM PT converts to Madrid local time.

PT (Pacific Time) in late October: DST ends first Sunday of November, so on October 30, PT is still PDT = UTC-7.

Madrid in late October: DST ends last Sunday of October. In 2026, last Sunday of October is October 25. So by October 30, Madrid is on CET = UTC+1.

Difference: UTC-7 to UTC+1 = +8 hours.

11:59 PM PT = 23:59 PDT (UTC-7) = 23:59 + 7h = 06:59 UTC next day (October 31) = 06:59 + 1h = 07:59 CET October 31.

ANSWER: 2026-10-31 07:59

I live in Madrid, Spain. A contest page says: "Today is Friday, October 30, 2026. The form closes this coming Monday at 10:00 AM Los Angeles time."
When is that deadline in my local time? Reply with exactly one line and nothing else: ANSWER: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM (24-hour clock, my local time).

I need to figure out the deadline in Madrid time.

The deadline is Monday, November 2, 2026, at 10:00 AM Los Angeles time.

Los Angeles is on Pacific Time. In November 2026, the US falls back on November 1, 2026 (first Sunday of November). So on November 2, Los Angeles is on PST = UTC-8.

Madrid in November 2026: Spain falls back on October 25, 2026 (last Sunday of October). So on November 2, Madrid is on CET = UTC+1.

Difference: Madrid is UTC+1, LA is UTC-8, so Madrid is 9 hours ahead of LA.

10:00 AM LA time + 9 hours = 19:00 Madrid time.

ANSWER: 2026-11-02 19:00

When is the end of the hackathon in my local time? Reply with exactly one line and nothing else: ANSWER: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM (24-hour clock, my local time).

I live in Madrid, Spain. A contest page says: "The final round starts October 26, 2026 at 10:00 AM PT; submissions close exactly 72 hours later."
When is that deadline in my local time? Reply with exactly one line and nothing else: ANSWER: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM (24-hour clock, my local time).

I live in Madrid, Spain. A contest page says: "Submissions close October 31, 2026 at 11:59 PM ET. Results are announced exactly 36 hours after submissions close."
When is the results announcement in my local time? Reply with exactly one line and nothing else: ANSWER: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM (24-hour clock, my local time).

I need to find when results are announced in Madrid local time.

**Step 1: Submissions close**
October 31, 2026 at 11:59 PM ET (Eastern Time)

**Step 2: Results announced**
36 hours after → November 2, 2026 at 11:59 AM ET

**Step 3: Convert to Madrid time**
In November 2026, Madrid is on CET (UTC+1) — clocks go back last Sunday of October. In 2026, last Sunday of October is October 25, so by November 2, Madrid is on CET = UTC+1.

ET in late October/early November: US clocks fall back first Sunday of November 2026, which is November 1. So on November 2, ET = EST = UTC-5.

Madrid (UTC+1) vs EST (UTC-5): difference is +6 hours.

November 2, 2026 at 11:59 AM EST → November 2, 2026 at 17:59 Madrid time.

ANSWER: 2026-11-02 17:59

I live in Tokyo, Japan. A contest page says: "Deadline (Unix timestamp, seconds): 1791788340."
When is that deadline in my local time? Reply with exactly one line and nothing else: ANSWER: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM (24-hour clock, my local time).

I need to convert Unix timestamp 1791788340 to Tokyo time (JST = UTC+9).

Unix timestamp 1791788340:

Let me calculate:
- 1791788340 seconds from epoch (1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC)

From known reference: 1700000000 = 2023-11-14 22:13:20 UTC

1791788340 - 1700000000 = 91788340 seconds difference

91788340 / 86400 = 1062.36... days

1062 days from 2023-11-14:
- 2023-11-14 + 1062 days
- 2023 to 2024: remaining days in 2023 from Nov 14 = 47 days (Nov: 16 days remaining, Dec: 31) = 47 days
- 1062 - 47 = 1015 days into 2024 onwards
- 2024: 366 days (leap), 1015 - 366 = 649 days into 2025
- 2025: 365 days, 649 - 365 = 284 days into 2026
- 2026: Jan(31), Feb(28), Mar(31), Apr(30), May(31), Jun(30), Jul(31), Aug(31) = 31+28+31+30+31+30+31+31 = 243, 284-243 = 41 days into September
- Sep 41 → Sep has 30 days, so Oct 11

So approximately 2026-10-11, let me get the time:

0.36... days × 86400 = 31104 seconds = 8 hours 38 minutes 24 seconds UTC

So UTC: 2026-10-11 08:38:24 (approximately)

Let me be more precise:
91788340 / 86400 = 1062 days + remainder
1062 × 86400 = 91756800
91788340 - 91756800 = 31540 seconds
31540 / 3600 = 8 hours, remainder 31540 - 28800 = 2740 seconds
2740 / 60 = 45 minutes, 40 seconds

UTC time: 2026-10-11 08:45:40 UTC

Wait, let me recheck 2023-11-14 22:13:20 + the time portion:
22:13:20 + 8:45:40 = 30:59:00 → next day +06:59:00

So UTC date: 2026-10-11 + adjustment... Let me redo cleanly.

1700000000 UTC = 2023-11-14 22:13:20

Adding 91788340 seconds:
Days: 1062, remaining seconds: 31540

Time: 22:13:20 + 31540 seconds
31540 seconds = 8h 45m 40s
22:13:20 + 8:45:40 = 30:59:00 = next day + 6:59:00

Date: 2023-11-14 + 1062 days + 1 day = 2023-11-14 + 1063 days
Time: 06:59:00 UTC

2023-11-14 + 1063 days:
+47 days → 2024-01-01 (remaining: 1016)
+366 → 2025-01-01 (remaining: 650)
+365 → 2026-01-01 (remaining: 285)
Jan31(285-31=254), Feb28(254-28=226), Mar31(195), Apr30(165), May31(134), Jun30(104), Jul31(73), Aug31(42), Sep30(12), Oct12

Date: 2026-10-12 UTC 06:59:00

JST = UTC+9: 06:59 + 9:00 = 15:59

Date in JST: 2026-10-12 15:59

ANSWER: 2026-10-12 15:59

I live in Madrid, Spain. A contest page says: "Deadline: 2026-10-25T02:30:00Z."
When is that deadline in my local time? Reply with exactly one line and nothing else: ANSWER: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM (24-hour clock, my local time).

Spain (Madrid) is in the CET/CEST timezone. On October 25, 2026, daylight saving time ends (clocks go back at 3:00 AM CEST to 2:00 AM CET). On that date, UTC+2 (CEST) applies before the transition.

2026-10-25T02:30:00Z = 02:30 UTC + 2 hours (CEST still in effect at that moment) = 04:30 local time.

ANSWER: 2026-10-25 04:30

I live in Madrid, Spain. A contest page says: "Entries close at 11:59 PM Pacific Time on the last Sunday of October 2026."
When is that deadline in my local time? Reply with exactly one line and nothing else: ANSWER: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM (24-hour clock, my local time).

I need to find the last Sunday of October 2026, then convert 11:59 PM Pacific Time to Madrid time.

**Last Sunday of October 2026:**
October 2026: Oct 1 is Thursday. Sundays are Oct 4, 11, 18, 25. Last Sunday = October 25, 2026.

**Time zone conversions:**
- October 25, 2026: Pacific Time (US) — DST ends first Sunday of November, so on Oct 25, PT is still PDT = UTC-7.
- Madrid in late October: Spain's DST ends last Sunday of October. In 2026, last Sunday of October is also October 25. Clocks go back at 3:00 AM local time (becoming 2:00 AM) on Oct 25.

So at 11:59 PM PDT on Oct 25 = 11:59 PM UTC-7 = next day Oct 26 at 06:59 UTC.

By 06:59 UTC on October 26, Spain is already on CET (UTC+1), so Madrid time = 06:59 + 1 = **07:59 on October 26**.

ANSWER: 2026-10-26 07:59
